dense_vs_checkpointed_numeric_gates.adam_state_structure: At both updates require exactly434 student state entries with matching per-Parameter step1 then2, same-shaped finite FP32 exp_avg/exp_avg_sq and no reference state. Defaults, parameter-group order/decay and optimizer kernel settings must match exactly. Any expected optional state must be identical in both branches, never ignored.

all434_raw_and_clipped_gradients.per_parameter_rms_rule: RMS(diff)<=1e-7+0.05*RMS(dense); all434 must have non-None finite FP32 gradients. Per-tensor mathematical near-zero gradients are not required to be nonzero.
all434_raw_and_clipped_gradients.scope: Compare each standalone three-witness gradient and actual accumulated gradients before clipping at both9-short update boundaries; then compare clipped tensors and the returned finite clip norm.

dense_vs_checkpointed_numeric_gates.caveat: These proposed relative/absolute floors are intended to distinguish BF16 rounding from broken autograd/normalization/optimizer integration. They may still reject a correct implementation and are not a universal BF16 error theorem. Such failure is an engineering result, not permission to relax gates, inspect accuracy, try a second implementation automatically or claim native parity.

clip_norm.scope: Pre-clip norm as returned by the same frozen owned finite-update guard, and the same positive clip coefficient<=1; native Trainer max_grad_norm remains0.

fresh_backbone_final_normalized_hidden.scope: Fresh equal weights on all three short witnesses, before optimizer updates; the decoder execution and shape have not changed.

head_logits.scope: Every full-vocabulary value at every aligned active short position, using bounded copied head outputs. Compare both student and anchored reference. Do not retain a graph or long full logits for telemetry.

dense_vs_checkpointed_numeric_gates.status: Prospectively frozen exact thresholds; no actual original-model comparison has occurred. No after-outcome relaxation.
dense_vs_checkpointed_numeric_gates.sum_metrics: Where raw token sums are recorded, compare their divided-by-exact-count means with the corresponding frozen mean bounds. Record unscaled sums too; do not apply a scalar1e-6 tolerance to a31776-token sum and confuse association error with the declared mean objective. No absent-EOS case is accepted by the native response guard.

total_loss.formula_check: For each branch independently, loss=weighted_ce+beta*kl at absolute1e-6. SFT and CEKL effective weights are exactly1 and SFT KL exactly0. This also checks no duplicated accumulation division in compute_loss.

update2_deltas.definition: For each branch independently subtract its same verified initial FP32 tensor from its actual after-update2 tensor, compare actual stored deltas in FP64 reductions, and require positive group norms and at least one changed tensor in each tied/backbone group. Do not compare only weights whose magnitude dwarfs the update, infer update from LR, or substitute moment initialization for a changed weight.

updated_full_weights.scope: Every434 updated FP32 tensor, in addition to delta gates; this loose full-weight check alone is insufficient at a tiny warmup LR.

failure_rule: Any numerical or unchanged identity/memory gate failure stops this version, preserving every preceding result. No after-outcome tolerance/context/precision/backend/chunk change or implicit retry. No training/pilot/benchmark admission.

nine_short_ga8_exact_schedule.first_update: Observe real optimizer step1 and434 finite FP32 moment entries, but require every actual FP32 student tensor unchanged from its initial value because usedLR=0. This update is NOT proof of learning or nonzero weight update.
nine_short_ga8_exact_schedule.identity_and_recompute: Every presentation has a unique diagnostic presentation index but repeats one of three source IDs openly. nine_short_ga8_exact_schedule.loss_scaling: compute_loss returns an unscaled equal-example objective; model_accepts_loss_kwargs=false; pinned Trainer/Accelerate scale once by actual current_gradient_accumulation_steps8 then1. Match the independent mean-of8 and mean-of1 gradient oracle.
nine_short_ga8_exact_schedule.sampler: Explicit SequentialSampler, microbatch1, dataloader_drop_last=false, no resume or random reshuffle
nine_short_ga8_exact_schedule.second_update: Observe real optimizer step2 using peakLR/57, followed by scheduler advancement to2*peakLR/57. Require actual nonzero stored FP32 update in the tied head/embedding and in the remaining backbone group in both branches. Compare all434 deltas and moment tensors using the prospective gates.

strict_memory_measurement.coverage: Synchronize at declared phase boundaries; sample assigned-driver use as well as allocator allocated/reserved/current/peaks during initialization, dense short comparisons, chunk forward/recompute/backward, finite gradients/moments, Adam update, standard save and native reload. Record sampling limitation explicitly: sampled nonallocator use is not a continuous driver peak.
strict_memory_measurement.native_scope: Paired short success proves only this short comparison and exact implementation/runtime. It does not certify a single-candidate long process, general32K workload or all four objectives' long headroom. Release each case process completely; do not use a successful SFT case as CEKL/ASFT/prior memory evidence.
strict_memory_measurement.rule: Conservative used=max(observed allocator allocated peak, observed allocator reserved peak)+maximum sampled nonallocator bytes. Require actual_device_total-conservative_used>=max(17179869184,0.1*actual_device_total). Preserve the existing implementation's conservative aggregation rather than selecting a smaller favorable observation.

unchanged_existing_gates.scope: Keep these existing identity/reload/memory gates exactly. The different dense-versus-checkpointed BF16 error policy below never replaces or relaxes same-path original identity or saved-weight reload checks.
